newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia's Aug 1-25 palm oil exports 537,175t - SGS.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's Aug 1-25 palm oil exports 537,175t - SGS.

text.p: Cargo surveyor, Societe Generale de Surveillance (SGS) Malaysia Sdn Bhd said on Monday it estimated Malaysia's palm oil exports for August 1-25 at 537,175 tonnes compared with 521,904 tonnes for July 1-25.
It said the exports comprised 143,315 tonnes of RBD palmoil, 228,280 tonnes of RBD palm olein and 53,837 tonnes of RBD palm stearin. The other products accounted for 111,743 tonnes.
India was the top buyer during the period, taking 126,182 tonnes followed by Pakistan which bought 106,470 tonnes, China 39,575 tonnes and South Africa 33,291 tonnes.
Countries in the European Union bought 31,310 tonnes while Middle East countries took 43,600 tonnes.
